findings.title: Git SSL Verification Disabled
findings.message: Git is configured with http.sslVerify=false in the global config. This disables TLS certificate validation for all Git operations, exposing credentials and code to MITM attacks.

findings.title: npm Auth Token in .npmrc
findings.message: An npm authentication token was found in /Users/testuser/.npmrc. This token grants publish access to npm packages associated with this account.

findings.title: SSH Agent Forwarding Enabled
findings.message: SSH agent forwarding is enabled globally in /Users/testuser/.ssh/config. This can expose your SSH keys to compromised remote hosts.

findings.title: Credential Pattern in Shell History
findings.message: A pattern resembling a credential (e.g., password= or token= flag) was found in shell history. Credentials passed on the command line may be logged in plaintext.

findings.title: Plaintext Credentials in Git Config
findings.message: Git credential helper is set to store, which writes credentials to /Users/testuser/.git-credentials in plaintext. Any process with filesystem access can read these credentials.
